item.title: Deploying Hugo site on GitHub Pages
item.description: There is an excellent GitHub Action to build and deploy a Hugo site to GitHub Pages by Ben Selby. But, the problem is that the action requires Personal Access Token to operate which currently require classic token with a full access to all user repo. I’m not comfortable with that. Another issue, it seems that it is created to deploy to another git repo as it nukes the target and retain only a single commit.
